xyflip.finding: Stage837 used legacy Stage407 X. Current Stage631 X is exactly opposite in orientation (cellwise correlation -1); legacy flipped-Y and current Y have correlation +1.
xyflip.rule: Use Stage631 current x_um/y_um, equivalent to Stage198 rule: x mirrored within section; Y already flipped and must not be flipped again.

band_review.principle: Stage594 is conservative and leaves many RAW values unchanged. Residual bands therefore represent under-correction/display artifact risk, not Stage594 overcorrection.

display.fourway: current XY for all four versions; archived Stage420 per-gene vmax except Snap25 default cap=500 with exact archived-vmax companion
display.current_3d: Stage128-style white 3D; Stage594 expression; Stage631 current XY/depth; Stage198 gene thresholds

numeric_correction_boundary: Do not globally modify Stage594. Any new numeric correction must be section x gene targeted and pass mass, Fine26, R1-R5, and independent seam/RS-FISH checks.
